## 9. Security/failure modes (brief)

- Hash collision: assume SHA-256.
- Malicious producer tokenizing wrong: conformance + spot audits; root integrity unaffected (garbage propagates deterministically).
- KV poisoning: KV keyed by R; a bad actor can serve wrong KV under right key — mitigations: ATTEST events w/ signatures (out of root scope, noted).
- Rollback: bus is append-only; roots chain via head_event_id enabling fork detection.
